type: isolated implementation and correctness/recovery, NO performance timers
hypothesis: Move eligible obsolete-file remove_file calls off the Live publication thread with bounded owned work. Investigate from qualified 091/092, never from unqualified 095 tail attribution.

implementation.handoff: try_send, no wait; rejected handoff leaves original tracking intact
implementation.tracking: Original retired Arc remains until observed success; batch retains handles; preallocated per-file atomic success bitmap recorded immediately after actual remove_file success before fault hook
implementation.last_handle_close: Conservative first implementation retains original tracking. Final retired handle close/reconciliation may still cost the writer; do not claim all deletion/close cost moved.
implementation.ownership: Worker captures exact Archive lock Arc, Drop closes channel and joins worker before its lease/handles can release
implementation.errors: No ignored NotFound/permissions; partial successes reconcile exactly, failures/unstarted retryable; callback counts failure even without another append
implementation.selection: Same old-catalog generation/protected-chain predicate, only currently unpinned retired segments, no current/orphan/pending selection
implementation.disabled: Original full reclaim, default feature-disabled maintenance, formats/version/dependencies/sync/ACK/source/receipt/queue rules unchanged

correctness_requirements: Byte-identical outputs and old016/full/incremental cold readers
Independent complete catalog/receipt/generation/payload CRC and SQL/NumPy reference of every reached store
Anonymous/named exact ACK/retry/collision and source boundaries
Pinned snapshots and protected chains survive worker selection/new publication/compaction
Explicit two-inflight bound including executing and queued; no duplicate identities; rejected handoff unchanged
Real filesystem deletion failure, partial success, worker panic/disconnect and coherent retry
Callback error visible while idle; no poison from maintenance error
Drop/join drains before exclusive lease release; snapshot continues lease
Orphan999/pending998 remain exact; cold-reopen retired leftovers retained
fault_acceptance: Each fixed cut must reach actual declared eligible path/ordinal. Reconcile every emitted ACK, complete protected chain/digests/current CRC/row multiset after exit/error. Errors healthy and retryable. Pauses use owned marker release, no unrelated process stop. No physical power-loss/device-exhaustion claim.
performance: NONE in 096. Any later timing requires a new predeclared balanced same-D incremental A/A versus async candidate, no fault/tracing hooks, full+both halves, all previous p99/rate/memory/disk/loss guards. Arrival/drain unchanged; background completion/shutdown/final disk outside window explicitly accounted. Full release/competitor gates still required.
preservation: All sources/locks/binaries/raw stores/stdout/stderr/failures/unstarted cases and empty dirs retained; bounded ZIP SHA/CRC/set restoration plus independent audit with zero Native/timer launches before closing experiment
release: Supported 0.3.16 untouched; 0.3.17 unqualified, no ETA; local/private only
